*Auto-generated from CISA KEV, NVD and public advisories; summaries are AI-assisted.*

The day's reporting centers on three newly added CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities: an unsafe deserialization flaw in Idunno AntiCsrf (CVE-2026-131914, CVSS 9.3), a Drupal Core installer flaw that could allow site reinstallation via install.php (CVE-2026-132165), and an Optimizely Web Experimentation signup flaw allowing user impersonation and Project JavaScript modification (CVE-2026-132224, CVSS 7.1). Separately, ten CVEs scored 9.9–10.0 but none are listed in KEV; they include Microsoft Azure App Service for Linux (CVE-2026-109484), Apache JSPWiki and Jena Fuseki, hexpm, Spring AI, and Adobe Experience Manager. Five of them (CVE-2026-9790, -128791, -128797, -128798, and one more of the same family) affect the Acer Connect M6E 5G router, mostly through missing authentication or WAN-exposed admin interfaces. Advisories also flag unauthenticated RCE and command injection in ruflo MCP bridge and AVideo, plus ICS software notices from Danfoss, Schneider Electric, and AutomationDirect.

### Defender priorities
- Prioritize remediation of the three KEV additions (Idunno AntiCsrf, Drupal Core, Optimizely), since they are confirmed exploited. Check whether Idunno AntiCsrf is end-of-life, and audit Optimizely Project JavaScript for unauthorized changes.
- Patch or mitigate the CVSS 10.0 issues in Azure App Service for Linux, hexpm, Spring AI, and Apache JSPWiki/Jena Fuseki. Restrict exposure of the Acer Connect M6E router's port 8080 admin panel and its unauthenticated endpoints.
- Review the ruflo MCP bridge default Docker Compose deployments and AVideo instances for exposure, and consult the vendor advisories for the Danfoss, Schneider Electric, and AutomationDirect ICS products.

## CISA KEV additions (3)

- **[CVE-2026-131914](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-131914/)** — Idunno AntiCsrf · CVSS 9.3
  Idunno AntiCsrf deserializes untrusted data, which lets an unauthenticated remote attacker achieve code execution via object injection. The product may be end-of-life or end-of-service, and the flaw is known to be exploited.
- **[CVE-2026-132165](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-132165/)** — Drupal Core
  Drupal Core does not fail securely in its installer, so under specific conditions an unauthenticated attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall the site. This could lead to site takeover or arbitrary code execution, and it is known to be exploited.
- **[CVE-2026-132224](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-132224/)** — Optimizely Web Experimentation · CVSS 7.1
  Optimizely Web Experimentation's account signup flow allows external control of critical state data, letting an attacker impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. That JavaScript is then served from Optimizely-hosted assets and runs in browsers of visitors to affected customer sites. It is known to be exploited.

## New critical CVEs (15)

- **[CVE-2026-109484](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-109484/)** — Microsoft Azure App Service for Linux · CVSS 10.0
  Azure App Service for Linux fails to sanitize special elements (special element injection), allowing an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over the network. The CVSS score of 10.0 indicates severe impact.
- **[CVE-2026-128791](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-128791/)** — Acer Connect M6E 5G Portable WiFi Router · CVSS 10.0
  The Acer Connect M6E 5G Portable WiFi Router exposes a meeting-recording delete endpoint that accepts HTTP DELETE requests without authentication. Any WiFi client can permanently delete files, resulting in data loss.
- **[CVE-2026-128797](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-128797/)** — Acer Connect M6E 5G Portable WiFi Router · CVSS 10.0
  The web administration panel on port 8080 binds to all network interfaces, including public IPv6 addresses, making internal API endpoints reachable from the WAN without firewall protection. It is noted as related to CVE-2026-50224.
- **[CVE-2026-128798](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-128798/)** — Acer Connect M6E 5G Portable WiFi Router · CVSS 10.0
  The Acer Connect M6E 5G Portable WiFi Router exposes device information and meeting recording metadata to any connected WiFi client without requiring credentials. This is a missing authentication issue that leaks sensitive data to anyone on the network.
- **[CVE-2026-129514](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-129514/)** — hexpm · CVSS 10.0
  The hexpm application/vnd.hex+erlang request body parser deserializes untrusted Erlang external term data, letting an unauthenticated remote attacker execute operating system commands. The data states it was actively exploited against hex.pm on 2026-11-23.
- **[CVE-2026-59415](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-59415/)** — Spring Spring AI · CVSS 10.0
  Spring AI's TypesenseVectorStore delete operation builds a filter_by expression by concatenating caller-supplied document IDs without escaping. An ID containing filter-syntax characters can cause unintended documents to be deleted.
- **[CVE-2026-78114](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-78114/)** — Apache Software Foundation Apache JSPWiki · CVSS 10.0
  Apache JSPWiki does not replace the session identifier when a user logs in, which is a session fixation flaw. An attacker who can set a known session ID in a victim's browser can reuse it after the victim authenticates.
- **[CVE-2026-86155](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-86155/)** — Apache Software Foundation Apache Jena Fuseki · CVSS 10.0
  The SHACL validation functionality in Apache Jena Fuseki can be abused to cause server-side request forgery, making the server issue requests on an attacker's behalf. This can expose internal resources.
- **[CVE-2026-9790](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-9790/)** — Acer Connect M6E 5G Portable WiFi Router · CVSS 10.0
  The Acer Connect M6E 5G Portable WiFi Router exposes endpoints such as /user/hasSimCard, /user/pooling and /api/device-info without authentication to any WiFi client. This allows unauthorized access to device functionality and information.
